ThingDef.label: credit bond
ThingDef.description:
A physical, registered certificate issued by United Stellar Armament Company dealers to local factions during transactions. It is made from a special high-tenacity fiber paper and printed with special inks, carrying sophisticated anti-counterfeiting marks alongside the registered owner's details.
Surplus value from a deal with the United Stellar Armament Company can be converted into these certificates, locking in fixed purchasing power for the next one.
Because each certificate is registered, nobody but its owner can spend it - which makes this remarkably durable piece of paper essentially useless to any other faction on the rim.
